rows.grounds: numeral forming first member of compound with patra
noun forming second member of compound with aṣṭa
adjective qualifying cakraṃ, indicating presence of a central pericarp

items.question: What are the defining attributes of the sixth royal cakra?
premises: The sixth cakra is introduced as the object of description.
It possesses eight petals and a pericarp.
items.inference: The sixth cakra is a royal center distinguished by having eight petals and a central pericarp.
uncertainties: The exact referent of rājānam as a qualitative epithet or a specific name is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: And the sixth cakra is royal, having eight petals and a pericarp.
